components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: var(--primary, #c96442); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #c96442) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #c96442); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #c96442) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #3d3929); font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted, #f0eee6); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #c96442); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #c96442) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions next to a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e2d6); border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: var(--background, #faf9f5); color: var(--foreground, #3d3929); font: 500 14px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted, #f0eee6); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #c96442); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #c96442) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input, #dad6c8); border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #3d3929); font: 400 14px/1.4 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #83827d); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring, #c96442); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #c96442) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--primary, #c96442); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); font: 500 12px/1 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

Giải thích từ “serendipity” giúp mình nhé?

components.css: .ds-thread { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; width: 520px; padding: 24px; background: var(--background, #faf9f5); } .ds-msg-user { align-self: flex-end; max-width: 85%; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e2d6); border-radius: 21.6px 21.6px 9.6px 21.6px; background: var(--user-bubble, #f0eee6); color: var(--foreground, #3d3929); font: 400 15px/1.625 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-msg-reply { align-self: flex-start; max-width: 85%; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e2d6); border-radius: 21.6px 21.6px 21.6px 9.6px; background: var(--card, #fff); color: var(--card-foreground, #3d3929); font: 400 16.5px/1.7 'Source Serif 4 Variable', Georgia, serif; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Composer

components.css: .ds-composer { width: 520px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e5e2d6); border-radius: 21.6px; background: var(--card, #fff); box-shadow: 0 0.25rem 1.25rem rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--input, #dad6c8); } .ds-composer-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 16px 16px 0; border: 0; resize: none; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground, #3d3929); font: 400 15px/1.625 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; outline: none; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground, #83827d); } .ds-composer-bar { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 8px; } .ds-composer-send { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius, 12px); background: var(--primary, #c96442); color: var(--primary-foreground, #fff); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-composer-send:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary, #c96442) 80%, transparent); } .ds-composer-send:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring, #c96442) 50%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
Happier Chat feels like a quiet reading room with good light. Warm cream paper is the ground, walnut-brown ink carries the text, and one kiln-fired terracotta accent marks what you can act on. The assistant answers in a book serif, so a reply reads like a page someone wrote for you, while the interface around it (composer, sidebar, settings) speaks in a calm, neutral sans. Night mode is the same room after dark: lamplit charcoal, warm grey ink, and terracotta that glows a little brighter.

Density is relaxed but not sparse. The conversation sits in a centred column with generous line height, and the chrome steps back so the reply and the generative cards lead. Depth comes from tone (cream ground, white sheets, linen bubbles) and hairline sand borders, not from shadows. Components are soft and restrained: medium radii, thin borders, near-zero lift, and quick color-only hover changes.

The system rejects three looks: neon or gradient "AI" styling (glowing purple-blue, glassmorphism), cold enterprise dashboards (blue-grey, dense, clinical), and childish playfulness (candy colors, mascots, over-rounded blobs). "Happier" is carried by warmth, clarity, and small, considered motion, never by decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream / walnut / terracotta palette; every neutral leans warm.
Serif for the assistant's voice and display moments; sans for everything the user operates.
Flat, tonal layering with hairline borders; shadows only for floating layers.
One accent, used sparingly for actions, focus, and live states (speaking, active).
User-adjustable: chat text scales with `--chat-font-scale`, and users may override every color token in Appearance settings.

rules.name: The One Clay Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is the only UI accent. It marks actions, focus, and live state; it never fills large areas or decorates.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans yellow-brown. No cool greys, no blue-greys, no `#000` or `#fff` text on the page ground.

rules.name: The User's Palette Rule
rules.body: All color tokens are user-overridable (`src/lib/custom-colors.ts`). New UI must read colors from tokens (`bg-primary`, `bg-card`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`), never hard-code hex, so custom palettes keep working.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif belongs to the assistant and to display moments (greeting, brand wordmark in the sidebar, auth titles, word cards). Controls, menus, settings, and user input are always sans.

rules.name: The Reader's Scale Rule
rules.body: Conversation text uses `text-reply` / `text-chat`, which follow the user's font-scale setting. Never set conversation text in fixed sizes.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest are flat. A shadow means "this floats above the page", and nothing in the page flow floats.

dos: **Do** read every color from tokens (`primary`, `card`, `muted`, `border`…) so user palettes and dark mode keep working.
**Do** set assistant output in Source Serif 4 at `text-reply` with 1.7 leading, and user input in Geist at `text-chat`.
**Do** separate surfaces by tone and 1px sand borders; reserve `shadow-md` and above for floating layers.
**Do** keep terracotta for actions, focus, and live state.
**Do** design every string slot for more than two languages and longer translations.
donts: **Don't** use neon, purple-blue gradients, glows, or glassmorphism.
**Don't** drift into a cold enterprise dashboard: no blue-grey neutrals, no dense data-grid chrome in the conversation.
**Don't** go childish: no candy colors, mascots, or over-rounded blob shapes.
**Don't** introduce a second UI accent color; lavender is for charts only.
**Don't** hard-code hex values or fixed font sizes for conversation text.
**Don't** use solid red fills for destructive actions; use the brick tint.
